stop_reason: Final bounded look attempt: all three raw Cycles images and all three separately labeled HDR color-only OIDN versions were inspected. Geometry/thickness, shaped metal reflections, grounded support and reduced pale wash improved. However the hero stream loses visibility through a substantial middle section above the cup, so continuous pouring is not reliably readable. Darkening also suppresses some vessel/free-surface information; side remains dominated by bright reflected patches. This is a useful working CG prototype, not an accepted final beauty shot. Stop this run after three attempts; no fourth render is approved by this review. The review binds the raw three-view outputs, and qa/final_visual_review.json separately records denoised artifact hashes. No reference-photo match, GPU performance, browser appearance parity, fluid simulation, or final-film temporal quality is claimed.
